asset_or_sector: Bastion I-II player HUD feedback and legibility in published WebGL
diagnosis: Published exact-build captures show all disabled primary buttons (construction, recruitment, March, completion) with near-black text on a dark background. The recruitment timer was hidden by an incorrectly attached else-if; the screenshot during recruitment also mislabels the objective as a resource shortage after its cost has already been paid. Put the pending task and its remaining seconds in the large primary affordance while preserving canonical SHARP and gameplay.

validation.source_gate: Compare v0220 Bastion I-II contract with OWNER_I_II Unity runtime and inspect the exact published flow captures. Keep real state, persistence and SHARP authority.
validation.final_gate: Readable primary action in disabled/completed states and visible recruitment countdown; complete I-II exact-candidate and published landscape/portrait flow with zero runtime errors, unchanged state/persistence. Inspect matched captures.
validation.final_result: Bounded training countdown and disabled/completed CTA contrast PASS by direct candidate/public capture review in both orientations. Global art quality not certified.

escalation.on_next_visual_fail: Classify the failed UI state and rerun the same composition planner before another iteration; no new geometry or paid generation.

notes: Zero-spend bounded gameplay feedback correction; no Bastion III or broad art redesign.
